articles.title: Nvidia Beat Eases AI Fears, but TCS and Infosys Face a Cautious Open
articles.excerpt: Nvidia's $115.84 billion revenue and $130 billion forecast topped expectations, yet the relief faded in Asia and Infosys's US-listed shares fell after hours — leaving Indian IT stocks in focus, not in rally mode, on Thursday.
articles.nri_angle: Indian investors and US holders of Infosys and Wipro ADRs get a split signal: AI demand fears eased on Nvidia's numbers, but after-hours prices argue for a cautious Thursday open in Mumbai.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Infrastructure to Drive India's IT Spending to Rs 16.9 Trillion in 2027
articles.excerpt: Gartner forecasts 10.6% growth in India's IT spending next year, with cloud infrastructure up 40.3% and data centre systems up 28.4% as hyperscalers and global capability centres expand AI capacity.
articles.nri_angle: The forecast signals where India's tech jobs and GCC hiring will concentrate in 2027: AI infrastructure, cloud platforms and higher-value consulting rather than traditional labour-arbitrage services.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.title: India IT Spending Forecast by Segment, 2027

articles.title: AI Pays in Productivity but Trust Lags, TCS Study of 1,333 Executives Finds
articles.excerpt: 84% of senior leaders in TCS's Enterprise AI Study rank productivity as AI's top benefit, but only 10% let AI agents act without human approval - and security and governance now outrank cost and speed in deployment decisions.
articles.nri_angle: The findings set the terms for the global enterprise AI work that Indian IT firms, and the Indian professionals who staff their US and European client teams, compete for.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India and Nine Partners Sign San Francisco Declaration to Protect AI Supply Chains
articles.excerpt: The Pax Silica signatories agreed common definitions for the sensitive technologies and critical infrastructure behind AI, and five working groups to act on them — a declaration of shared understanding, not yet a rulebook.
articles.nri_angle: India's seat in the Pax Silica group shapes the trusted-supply-chain rules that Indian and Indian-American technology firms, chip designers and data-centre operators will build under.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Freshworks Alumni Raise $53 Million for Dreamteam, an AI-Native CRM Challenger
articles.excerpt: Anand Venkatraman, Senthil Kanthaswamy and Ramesh Parthasarathy have closed a Together Fund-led seed and an Accel-led Series A for a CRM whose records maintain themselves — with engineering in Chennai and more than 100 customers signed in three months of selling.
articles.image_caption: Dreamteam's co-founders — former Freshworks executives Anand Venkatraman, Senthil Kanthaswamy and Ramesh Parthasarathy — in the company's announcement photograph. The AI-native CRM startup announced $53 million across seed and Series A rounds on November 16, 2026.

sources.label: Dreamteam announcement (GlobeNewswire, via Business Partner Magazine)

articles.nri_angle: Dreamteam was founded by three alumni of Chennai-founded Freshworks, keeps its engineering team in Chennai, and counts Freshworks founder Girish Mathrubootham's Together Fund as its first institutional investor.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Apple Opens Health AI Study to Up to 200,000 iPhone Users
articles.excerpt: The Apple Health AI Usage Study, built with OpenEvidence, will track how up to 200,000 US participants trust, understand and act on AI health answers over more than a year.
articles.nri_angle: The study is US-only: diaspora readers in the US with an iPhone 15 Pro or later can enroll, while readers in India cannot join this study.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.note: US study; enrollment is limited to the United States

items.text: Enroll through the Apple Health AI Usage Study app

data_cards.title: Who Can Join the Study
data_cards.catch_text: The study app is not meant to diagnose or treat any condition, or replace the advice of medical professionals.

articles.title: Bharat Semi Raises $24 Million Seed Round to Build AI Image Sensors in India
articles.excerpt: The New Delhi startup, still pre-revenue, says it has design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon and targets first commercial production in 2027.
articles.image_caption: Bharat Semi co-founders Vinayak Dalmia (left) and Vrinda Kapoor at the company office.
articles.nri_angle: An Indian-founded chip startup is hiring in Santa Clara and selling to U.S. customers, a concrete example of India-based deep-tech firms building for the American market.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Patches 1,094 Flaws, Including an Outlook Zero-Day Already Exploited
articles.excerpt: November's Patch Tuesday fixes 1,094 Microsoft CVEs. The one to install first closes an Outlook spoofing flaw, already exploited, that can leak a user's NTLMv2 credential hash.
articles.nri_angle: The exploited Outlook flaw matters to anyone — including the diaspora's large IT workforce — who uses Outlook at work: update now, because opening one crafted message file can leak network credentials.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian IT Stocks Jumped 18% in October. Earnings Will Decide What Next
articles.excerpt: The Nifty IT index posted its best month in over six years as the global AI trade cooled. September-quarter results beat low expectations and AI revenue is now material — but analysts say December-quarter conversion is the real test.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors holding Indian IT through funds or direct listings should watch December-quarter deal conversion and constant-currency growth, not the October index jump, as the recovery test.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: After Jensen Huang: What Founder Exits Did to Apple, Alphabet and Uber
articles.excerpt: Nvidia's co-founder resigned with no named successor and no reason given. The record of Apple, Alphabet, Uber and Twitter shows preparation — not the founder's genius — decides what happens next.
articles.image_caption: File photograph of Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang. Huang resigned as president, chief executive and board member on November 12, 2026, and Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress is serving as interim chief executive.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers and investors are heavily represented at Nvidia and across the U.S. AI sector, making the succession outcome a direct workplace and portfolio story for the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ola Electric Hands Sales to Dealers as Registrations Fall 19.5% in September Quarter
articles.excerpt: The company that built its name on direct-to-consumer stores has appointed 255 dealer partners running 319 stores, targets about 700 by March 2027, and stopped taking orders through its own stores on November 1.
articles.image_caption: An Ola Electric scooter — the company is handing sales to dealers after registrations fell 19.5% in the September quarter
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors holding Ola shares since the IPO, the dealer pivot is the company's central bet on restoring growth and cash flow.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Warns Phishing Campaign Is Exploiting Its 365 Outage to Steal Passwords
articles.excerpt: Fake 'Outage' emails claim messages held during the November 12 disruption will be deleted in 24 hours. Microsoft says the activity is consistent with credential phishing and lists three sender domains to block.
articles.image_caption: Queueing Air Asia passengers at I Gusti Ngurah Rai airport, Bali. The emails claim messages held during the outage will be deleted within 24 hours unless recipients click to restore them.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora professionals whose workplaces run on Microsoft 365 are the campaign's target group; the check takes two minutes in the official admin centre, not in the email.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Valuation Reset Could Benefit Indian IT Firms, Senior Official Says
articles.excerpt: As Nvidia's slide forces a reassessment of AI spending, a senior government official told Moneycontrol that moderating investment and a capital rotation could favour Indian IT services — with early FPI data mixed.
articles.nri_angle: A client shift from AI building to AI implementation would affect deal flow and hiring at Indian IT firms that employ large numbers of diaspora tech workers, and the FPI rotation affects diaspora portfolios holding both US AI and Indian IT stocks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Nifty IT index rise in one session

articles.title: Microsoft Restores Outlook, Teams and Copilot After Outage Lasting Over 36 Hours
articles.excerpt: Microsoft confirmed early Saturday that corrective work is complete after a network fault disrupted Microsoft 365 in more than 70 countries, though delayed email is still being cleared and a full post-incident report is pending.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian IT teams and diaspora workplaces that run on Outlook and Teams, the restoration ends more than 36 hours of disrupted email and scheduling, though delayed messages are still clearing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: LangChain Raises $300 Million at $3 Billion Valuation Led by CapitalG
articles.excerpt: LangChain's Series C brings total funding to $460 million, the company said. More than 7,000 organizations use LangSmith, its platform to run, improve and govern AI agents.
articles.nri_angle: LangChain's agent platform is widely used by Indian-origin developers and enterprise teams building AI products, and its $3 billion valuation marks the scale of the agent-infrastructure market they work in.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Rolls Into Second Day, Knocking Out Indian Airlines' Email Support
articles.excerpt: Outlook and Exchange Online have been failing worldwide since Thursday evening. IndiGo and Akasa Air warned passengers their email support is down, Air India rerouted its mail, and Microsoft — reporting only 'marginal success' by Friday afternoon — has given no time for full recovery.
articles.image_caption: An aerial view of Microsoft campus buildings. Microsoft 365 services including Outlook and Exchange Online were disrupted worldwide from Thursday evening, affecting airline email support in India.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora travellers and India-based teams running on Microsoft 365 face the same dead inbox today; the actionable point is to reach Indian airlines through apps and phone lines, not email, until service is restored.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Claude Login Outage Locked Users Out for Two Hours Friday
articles.excerpt: Anthropic's status page logged an authentication incident at 09:58 UTC on November 13 affecting claude.ai, Claude Code, the Console and Cowork, resolved at 11:58 UTC, followed by a separate degraded-performance incident resolved at 15:38 UTC.

sources.label: MadRobot — Claude Down: Sign-in Outage Hits claude.ai and Claude Code
AI Weekly — Anthropic Logs Login Outage on Claude.ai and Claude Code

articles.nri_angle: The outage hit during Asia-Pacific evening hours and was widely reported by users in India, affecting Indian engineers and teams in the U.S. and India who rely on Claude Code and claude.ai for daily work.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Google Unveils Gemini Intelligent Eyewear From $395, On Sale December 10
articles.excerpt: The display-free Android XR glasses, made with Samsung, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, pair Gemini voice help with a 12-megapixel camera - but only with Pixel, select Galaxy and newer iPhones at launch.
articles.image_caption: The Warby Parker Alden frame in pine, part of Google's Intelligent Eyewear collection. The 12-megapixel camera sits in the frame's front corner. Official Google product image.
articles.image_credit: Google / Warby Parker / Samsung (official product images)
articles.nri_angle: The glasses launch first in the US, Canada and South Korea, with real-time translation across more than 70 languages.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Its Fast Model for Agentic Work
articles.excerpt: Hydrogen takes the execution tier of the Gemini 4 family: faster than the old Flash line, priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens, and now running inside Google Search for all users.
articles.nri_angle: Indian developers and IT teams are among the heaviest users of Google's AI stack; a cheaper, faster execution model changes the cost math for agent-based development work.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ISRO Test-Fires Revised PSLV Third Stage After Two Flight Anomalies
articles.excerpt: The strengthened PS3 solid motor was successfully ground-tested at Sriharikota on November 12 after anomalies on PSLV-C61 and PSLV-C62; ISRO says further tests will follow a detailed review of the data, and has not declared the vehicle ready to fly.
articles.image_caption: A solid motor fires during a ground static test at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. ISRO tested the revised PSLV third stage on November 12 after anomalies on two earlier missions.
articles.nri_angle: The PSLV is the vehicle that has carried many of the Indian and commercial satellites diaspora-linked startups and universities fly; its return to flight depends on this qualification sequence.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.event: Static test of revised PS3 conducted

articles.title: Chinese AI Firms Rush to Reserve Overseas Nvidia Capacity Amid Curbs Fear
articles.excerpt: Reuters, citing three people familiar with the matter, reported Chinese AI companies are trying to rent Nvidia-powered capacity overseas over fears Washington will regulate remote access to restricted processors.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin tech professionals and investors in the US AI sector are directly affected by how Washington draws the line between chip exports and remote cloud access.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Affordability Will Decide AI Winners in India, Peak XV's Anandan Says
articles.excerpt: In NDTV's Walk The Talk, Rajan Anandan argues homegrown companies building smaller, cost-effective models for real-world use can win at home and compete globally, even as AI reshapes outsourcing and software jobs.
articles.nri_angle: Anandan's affordability and jobs arguments speak directly to Indian-origin founders, investors and tech workers in the US watching India's AI build-out.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Top AI Researchers in the US

articles.title: Adobe and Google Deepen Pact: Gemini Reaches Photoshop, Acrobat Comes to Gmail
articles.excerpt: Announced at Adobe MAX on November 10, the expanded partnership puts PDF editing inside Gmail and Drive and Google's AI models inside Adobe's creative apps — though key pieces have no launch date yet.
articles.nri_angle: Adobe and Google tools are daily infrastructure for the diaspora's large tech and creative workforce; the Gmail-to-Acrobat path removes a routine friction from office work.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: monthly active users of Adobe's tools

articles.title: TCS Becomes Official AI and Technology Partner of the Rio Marathon
articles.excerpt: The partnership, announced November 11, is TCS's first marathon sponsorship in Latin America and adds Latin America's largest street race to its 14-event global running portfolio.
articles.nri_angle: TCS is one of the most recognisable Indian employers for the diaspora tech workforce; Rio extends its marathon brand platform into Latin America, where it employs 26,000 people.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.event: TCS announced as Official AI and Technology Partner
25th anniversary edition of the Rio Marathon

articles.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Tops AI Benchmark by One Point, but Opus Keeps Coding Lead
articles.excerpt: Google's new model leads the Artificial Analysis index and hallucinates far less than Opus 5.5 — though more than its own predecessor. Anthropic still wins on coding agents.
articles.image_caption: Google Gemini artificial intelligence. Gemini 4 Carbon tops an AI benchmark by one point while Claude Opus keeps the coding lead.
articles.nri_angle: Indian and diaspora engineering teams choosing an AI model get a clear split: Carbon for factual workloads, Opus for coding agents, at identical list prices from December.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Said to Draw Orders Several Times the Shares on Offer
articles.excerpt: Bloomberg reported the order book was covered on day one of the roadshow. The $70–$78 range values the Claude maker near $1.4 trillion, and bankers are said to be weighing a higher price.
articles.nri_angle: The debut will price the AI sector for every diaspora investor holding US tech funds; pricing is expected the night before the November 19 listing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Investor roadshow begins; shares marketed at $70 to $78
Targeted Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT

articles.title: Google's November Pixel Drop Brings Gemini Intelligence to the Pixel 10
articles.excerpt: Rambler, multi-step task automation and proactive suggestions reach last year's flagships, alongside a $29.99 Pixel Tag tracker and a smarter Call Screen for the Pixel 11.
articles.image_caption: A Google Pixel phone stands on a shelf, showing its rear camera bar and Google logo. The November Pixel Drop brings Gemini Intelligence to the Pixel 10 series.
articles.nri_angle: Multi-step Gemini automation in this Drop is available in India as well as the UK and Japan, and conversation summaries now include Hindi, making the update directly relevant to diaspora Pixel owners and their families in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao Holds Stake Calculated at About $703 Million Ahead of IPO
articles.excerpt: Moneycontrol's calculations from Anthropic's IPO filing put CFO Krishna Rao's stake at about $703 million, or roughly Rs 6,500 crore. The filing itself lists Rao, 43, with 9,497,900 shares beneficially owned, mostly in stock options, the largest holding of any non-founder.
articles.nri_angle: Rao's roughly Rs 6,500 crore calculated stake makes the Indian-origin CFO one of the most prominent diaspora figures in the AI industry's largest listings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jay Puri Among Names Reported in Nvidia Succession Talk as Board Backs Huang
articles.excerpt: Nvidia has named no successor to Jensen Huang and its board says it backs him during an independent investigation, but AP reporting cited by Inshorts lists former worldwide sales chief Jay Puri, CFO Colette Kress, chief scientist Bill Dally and co-founder Chris Malachowsky among possible frontrunners if the board ever acts.
articles.nri_angle: Puri's presence on the reported frontrunner list puts an Indian-origin executive at the centre of the succession question at the world's most valuable chip company, though Nvidia has named no successor.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
